factual_claims.source_evidence: Energy business segment section (page 13) confirms 18 TWh LNG cargoes in both years. Macroeconomic development section (page 18) notes a 9% decline in regional gas consumption and describes price volatility drivers.

factual_claims.claim: The Group expanded its portfolio through the acquisition of 96.6% of Estonia Farmid and 100% of Oisu Biogaas, while continuing investments in biomethane, solar generation, battery storage and real estate.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Events in 2025 section (page 13) details the Estonia Farmid and Oisu Biogaas acquisitions. Management Report (page 11) and Sustainability Report (page 64) mention ongoing investments in biomethane, solar, battery storage, and real estate.

factual_claims.claim: These developments supported Infortar's strategy of diversification and more stable cash flows.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report (page 11) explicitly states: 'Infortar's mission is to build a crisis-resilient and inflation-proof dividend aristocrat... Diversification is a practical tool for us... when one is under pressure, another offsets it.'

factual_claims.claim: The financial position strengthened despite continued investment and dividend payments.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures of 2025 section (page 15) shows equity increased to EUR 1.175 billion from EUR 1.166 billion, liquidity improved to EUR 219.8 million from EUR 167.6 million, and the equity ratio improved to 45% from 43%.

factual_claims.claim: Total assets decreased 4.4% to EUR 2.597 billion, while equity increased to EUR 1.175 billion from EUR 1.166 billion and the equity ratio improved to 45% from 43%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position (page 114) shows total assets of EUR 2,596,607 thousand (4.4% decrease) and equity of EUR 1,175,404 thousand (increase from EUR 1,166,221 thousand). Equity ratio improved from 43.0% to 45% as noted in Key Figures (page 15).

factual_claims.claim: Interest-bearing liabilities declined 12.4% to EUR 1.071 billion, net debt fell to EUR 851.6 million, and net debt to EBITDA improved from 4.0 to 3.7.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position (page 114) shows interest-bearing liabilities of EUR 1,071,353 thousand (12.4% decrease). Key Figures (page 15) states net debt decreased to EUR 851,582 thousand and net debt/EBITDA improved from 4.0 to 3.7.

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow increased significantly to EUR 384.0 million from EUR 89.3 million, and year-end cash rose to EUR 219.8 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Cash Flow Statement (page 117) shows operating cash flow of EUR 383,971 thousand (increase from EUR 89,288 thousand) and cash and cash equivalents of EUR 219,771 thousand at year-end.
